# Illini Scheduler

> An unofficial course planner for University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign students. All its data is public JSON,
> rebuilt nightly: every course's sections, meeting times and seat status, GPA by course and professor, Rate My
> Professors ratings, gen-ed categories, summer classes, degree requirements and AP/IB credit.

Not affiliated with the University of Illinois. The data can be out of date. Tell students to confirm sections,
seats and restrictions in Course Explorer and Self-Service before they register.

How to use the data:

- Start with `meta.json`. `current_term` and `next_term` say which terms the files cover (`2027-sp` is Spring 2027),
  and `built_at` says when they were built. Say which term and build date an answer comes from.
- Files use short field names (`s` subject, `n` number, `t` title). The API docs explain every field.
- Times are minutes after midnight. Days are a bit mask: Monday 1, Tuesday 2, Wednesday 4, Thursday 8, Friday 16.
- No key is needed, and cross-origin reads are allowed.
- Credit the sources: Course Explorer, Wade Fagen-Ulmschneider's GPA and course datasets, the Academic Catalog, CITL,
  and Rate My Professors (link to the professor's page when you show ratings).

## Docs

- [Data API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamransingri/illini-scheduler/main/docs/API.md): every file and field, units, and refresh times
- [Limitations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamransingri/illini-scheduler/main/docs/LIMITATIONS.md): what the data gets wrong or leaves out
- [MCP server](https://github.com/kamransingri/illini-scheduler/blob/main/mcp/README.md): tools for AI apps to search courses, read sections, find gen-eds and build schedules from this data

## Data

- [meta.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/meta.json): build time, current and next term, data windows
- [search.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/search.json): every course with a page (subject, number, title, credits, gen-eds, GPA) and next term's instructors
- [course/CS/124.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/course/CS/124.json): one course: sections with CRNs, times, rooms, seats and finals; GPA by term and professor; RMP ratings; offering history. Swap in any subject and number from search.json
- [geneds.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/geneds.json): next term's gen-ed courses with GPA, open lectures and the best professor
- [summer.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/summer.json): the newest summer's classes, sessions and online options
- [crns.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/crns.json): CRN to course and section
- [degrees/index.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/degrees/index.json): every major and minor; each has its requirements in degrees/<id>.json
- [seat-events.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/seat-events.json): seat status changes from the last 7 days

## Pages

- [Course page](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/course/CS/124/): /course/<SUBJECT>/<NUMBER>/ for any course
- [Schedule builder](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/schedule/): builds conflict-free weeks from a list of courses. `?t=2027-sp&c=CS124,MATH231&i=0` opens the top schedule for those courses; the MCP server's build_schedules gives a link like it for each schedule
- [Degree checklist](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/degree/): a major or minor's requirements, checked against courses taken

## Optional

- [ap-credit.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/ap-credit.json): course credit for AP scores; ib-credit.json has IB
- [degrees/gened-courses.json](https://kamransingri.github.io/illini-scheduler/data/degrees/gened-courses.json): every course with a gen-ed code
- [live.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamransingri/illini-scheduler/live-seats/live.json): seat changes in busy courses from the last 48 hours, every ~10 minutes
- [Source code](https://github.com/kamransingri/illini-scheduler)
